svg.title: Finger width
svg.desc: Two top views of one plate of the two-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with hand size set to Measure my hand, a 20 mm wide plug in teal. Right: finger width at 26 mm. Marked in red: 1, the zip stations: the three small holes along each arm. 2, the finger lobes, the arms and the plate edge: the two rounded lobes in the lower half; the two toothed arms in the upper half; the outer outline.
